summary.text: Mia Ackerman is a Democratic state representative from District 45 who took office in 2013 and is seeking re-election; she advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as a title examiner.

paragraphs.text: Ackerman earned a B.A. in Political Economics from the State University of New York at Binghamton, and her professional experience includes working as a self-employed real estate title examiner, according to Ballotpedia.
In Ballotpedia's account of her 2014 campaign website, she referred to her service on the Cumberland Town Council.
